author: Bullard, Steven (tr.)
title: Japanese Army Operations in the South Pacific Area: New Britain and Papua Campaigns, 1942–43
edition: English translation of extracts from the Senshi Sōsho volumes covering the South Pacific Area
notes: The Japanese army's own account of Papua, Kokoda, Milne Bay and New Britain, in English — and therefore the single most useful Japanese-side source in this registry for the first year of the island war, because it covers ground the packs will actually stand on. Cite it against source:milner-1957 wherever the two disagree about what the Japanese command intended, which is often. The Australian War Memorial formerly offered the whole translation as a free page-numbered PDF from its Japanese Research Project site; that address now returns 404 and no replacement was found, so the url is the Memorial's catalogue record for the printed book. No page may be written from it until a copy is in hand. Its ISBN is given in secondary listings but was not confirmed against the item and is omitted.
